name: Highest Honor
descriptionTemplate: At turn start, if HP is below 25%, gain [Arg1] Temporary {STR}.
lore:
An elegant and mysterious black short-haired cat, said to be revered as a deity in a distant desert kingdom. The name of that deity has now been lost to time.
Worshipped, revered, forgotten—perhaps this is the fate of all gods.
